title: Arrow of Salving

sources.title: Arrow of Salving
markers: * Cure your target of {{Condition Type|Poisoned}},{{Cond|Paralysed}} and {{condition Type|Blinded}} conditions.

summary: Removes Poisoned, Paralysed and Blinded from the target. Uses the entire Action, including when you have Extra Attack.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Removes Poisoned, Paralysed and Blinded from the target. Uses the entire Action, including when you have Extra Attack.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Clear a disabling condition on an ally at range.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Hit rule: Automatically hits unless a preventing effect such as Reflectoguard Active or Reflective Shell interferes.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
